title: Replacement System Installations Contract Price, Package Availability and Municipal Permit Fees
content:
# Contract price, package availability and permit fees

## 1. Contract price

1.1 The contract price of a Replacement System Installations contract is the package's price for the contracted capacity: the package price for 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0 or 5.0 tons. No other capacity is sold.

1.2 A written proposal is signed at its quoted price only within the package's proposal period (calendar days from the day the proposal is written). After that period the proposal is re-priced from the current package prices.

## 2. What the contract price includes

The contract price includes:

- the equipment and specifications of the package — its manufacturer, cooling efficiency, furnace efficiency, heat pump heating efficiency, compressor staging, blower type, sound rating, refrigerant, thermostat and filter housing;
- removal and disposal of the old equipment, where the package includes it;
- the Manual J load calculation, where the package includes it;
- the start-up commissioning report, where the package includes it;
- the surge protector, the humidifier and the UV light, each where the package includes it;
- the condensate pump, where the package includes it and the drain needs one;
- a new line set, where the package includes it;
- duct transitions up to the package's included linear footage.

## 3. Package availability

A package is contracted only for a residential service address with existing ductwork, at one of the six listed capacities, on a proposal signed within the proposal period. The Harbison Performance Hybrid Heat Pump System, whose heat pump is paired with a gas furnace, additionally requires gas service at the address for its furnace.

## 4. Municipal permit fee

Where the package requires a municipal permit, the permit fee is billed as a separate permit-fee charge when the project is scheduled, at the fee for the project's municipality.

| Permitting jurisdiction | Permit fee |
|---|---|
| Columbus | $112.00 |
| Dublin | $135.00 |
| Westerville | $95.00 |
| Hilliard | $105.00 |
| Grove City | $90.00 |
| Gahanna | $100.00 |
| Upper Arlington | $125.00 |
| Worthington | $110.00 |
| Franklin County (unincorporated) | $85.00 |
| Delaware County (unincorporated) | $80.00 |

## 5. Illustrations (hypothetical contracts)

- A hypothetical 3.0-ton contract is priced at the package's 3.0-ton price; a 2.75-ton system is not a capacity that is sold.
- A hypothetical proposal written on the 1st of a month and signed on the 20th falls inside a 30-day proposal period and is signed at its quoted price; signed on the 5th of the second month after it was written, it is re-priced from the current package prices.
- A hypothetical project in Hilliard carries a $105.00 permit-fee charge, posted when the project is scheduled, not at signing.
